details:
Description

On initial opening of friend's list, I am able to see which friends are in friends or friends+ instances. Joining is normal/functional as usual. However, after leaving the instance and rechecking the friend's list, the same friends are now listed as "in private instance" with a green light despite no instance change. 

Reproduction Steps

Reproducible by joining friends/friends+, leaving, and checking friends list to see it is now changed to "private instance". Untested with friends in public instances.

Restarting VRChat fixes it, but issue reappears when reproduction steps performed. Request invite used to join instance after bug appears.
